description: Test jsonb_array_elements in select-list position: unlike jsonb_each, this is SETOF jsonb (a scalar per row), so the column really is json
name: jsonb_array_elements_select_list
query_sql:
-- @name GetDocItemsSelectList
-- @returns :many
SELECT id, jsonb_array_elements(data->'items') AS item FROM documents
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE documents (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, data JSONB NOT NULL, metadata JSONB);
